analysis: src/greeter.ts: checked correctness (template literal migration, trim semantics), conventions (naming), tests (no test file in diff — coverage gap noted), subtle bugs (register guard only rejects empty string, not whitespace). findings.title: Whitespace-only keys pass the empty-key guard
findings.description: The new guard rejects only the exact empty string. A key of " " passes and registers an entry that lookups by trimmed key will never find.
findings.suggestion:
-  if (key === "") throw new Error("key must not be empty")
+  if (key.trim() === "") throw new Error("key must not be empty")
findings.failure_scenario: register(" ", "value") succeeds; a later lookup for the trimmed key returns undefined and the entry is orphaned.

findings.title: Trim behavior change has no test
findings.description: greet() now trims its input — a behavioral change with no corresponding test update in this PR.
findings.failure_scenario: A later refactor that drops the trim would ship silently; no test fails.
